email_subject: Application - Social Media Manager at Netrex Solutions
email_body:
Dear Netrex Solutions team,

I'm applying for the Social Media Manager role. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and content, I know how to plan calendars, write captions that fit a brand's voice, and use data to improve engagement. I've managed social media integration for client websites, created content for e-commerce and consultancy brands, and I'm comfortable with scheduling tools and Canva. I also bring technical skills in web and AI that help me spot trends and automate reporting.

I'd love to help grow Netrex's presence and that of your clients. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm excited to apply for the Social Media Manager position at Netrex Solutions. Your focus on AI, web development, and digital marketing aligns perfectly with my blend of creative content skills and technical know-how.

In my current roles as a freelance digital marketer and junior digital marketer at Episto, I've planned and created content for client websites, managed CMS platforms like WordPress and Shopify, and used analytics to refine strategy. I've written SEO blog posts, coordinated with designers for visual assets, and integrated social media into client sites. While I haven't managed brand social accounts full-time, I've applied the same principles—audience research, engaging copy, and performance tracking—to grow organic traffic and engagement. I'm comfortable with scheduling tools like Buffer and Meta Business Suite, and I use Canva daily for basic editing.

What draws me to Netrex is the chance to own a brand's voice across platforms and contribute to client success. I'm eager to bring my experience in content creation, community management, and data-driven optimization to your team. I'm also quick to learn new tools and trends, and I thrive in collaborative environments.

Thank you for considering my application. I'd welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can help Netrex and its clients grow their social media presence.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

• Technical background in web development and AI, enabling automation and trend analysis
